The fuel oil system included seven different sizes of duplex 
 filter.

The function of filter is cleaning mazout oil from impurities 
 before pumps and burners.

Turn of hand "2" in fig 1 to isolate mazout inlet and mazout outlet to the 
 filter.
Close steam and condensate valves 6,7.
Open vent valve 5.
Open drain valve 8.
Screw off nuts 4 to remove filter cover 3.
Take out the filter insert from the hand 9.
Clean the outside surface of the strainers by using steam or clean solar.

Screw off nuts 14 to separate the inside and outside strainers 13,12 from 
 upper and lower flanges 10,11.
Clean the outside and inside strainers and all parts by clean fluid.
Check upper flange seals and lower flange seals and replace the damage seal

Check the gasket between the filter cover 3 and filter flange 15 and renewed 
 it if needed.

India
Introduction
This document out lines the equipment inspection, which must be 
 performed depending on ∆P as indicated in the above title block.
The fuel oil system included seven different sizes of duplex 
 filter.
The function of filter is cleaning mazout oil from impurities 
 before pumps and burners.
Technical Specification Of The Filters
Solar oil Suction Filter
 (M. Bir)
The first draft initiated and tested 
 by eng. Gamal Elsyed 
 Eseily, reviewed by eng. Sobhey 
 Abdel Haleem, approved by eng. Mohamed Sayed Abd El Ghaffar: general director 
 of Al-Arish Power Station.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman 
 EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general director and 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tools set.
Cleaning fluid.
Work to be Carried Out
The duplex filter show in fig "1" has two sections. One in service & 
 the other at standby.
The hand "2 is used to change over between the two sections.
Turn of hand "2" in fig 1 to isolate mazout inlet and mazout outlet to the 
 filter.
Close steam and condensate valves 6,7.
Open vent valve 5.
Open drain valve 8.
Screw off nuts 4 to remove filter cover 3.
Take out the filter insert from the hand 9.
Clean the outside surface of the strainers by using steam or clean solar.
Screw off nuts 14 to separate the inside and outside strainers 13,12 from 
 upper and lower flanges 10,11.
Clean the outside and inside strainers and all parts by clean fluid.
Inspection
Check upper flange seals and lower flange seals and replace the damage seal
Check the gasket between the filter cover 3 and filter flange 15 and renewed 
 it if needed.
Assembly the Filter Strainers insert inside the 
 Filter Body
Put the inside and outside strainers between the upper and lower flange and 
 tighten the nuts (14)
Put the filter strainers inside the filter body.
Tight the nuts 4 in cross sequence.
Filter Operation
Close the drain valve 8.
Open steam and condensate valves 6,7.
Open a balance pressure valve between two sections up to the mazout come out 
 the vent pipe then close vent valve 5
Turn off hand 2 to put this filter section in service and isolate the other 
 section by coordination with operation shift eng.
Check ∆P on this filter.
You can put this filter section in service after checking the ∆P on this filter 
 and Return the work permit by coordination with operation shift engineer.
